test_join_world_compliance: test that a client can successfully join a dm_env_rpc world with valid settings
test_leave_world_compliance: test that a client can leave a joined world or leave without having joined
test_join_world_error_handling: test that joining with an invalid world name or invalid settings raises DmEnvRpcError
test_action_observation_specs: test that action and observation specs have unique names and consistent tensor shapes
test_rejoin_world_after_leaving: test that a client can rejoin a world after leaving it successfully
